in_marathi.name: Indraneel
in_marathi.long_meaning: Indraneel हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Indraneel is derived from the Sanskrit words indra, meaning rain-god, and neel, meaning blue. The name signifies the deep blue hue of the monsoon sky and is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity.

The name signifies the deep blue hue of the monsoon sky and is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity.
